title: L1-Interference Spotter (Mandarin → English)
description: Reference and triage tool covering 8 major Mandarin–English transfer error categories: articles, tense/aspect, topic-comment order, copula omission, classifiers, phonological transfer, question formation, and negation. Includes a quick quiz.
regulatory_citations: Swan, M. & Smith, B. (2001). Learner English, 2nd edition. Cambridge University Press.
Li, C.N. & Thompson, S.A. (1981). Mandarin Chinese: A Functional Reference Grammar. University of California Press.
